Alex / team — quick technical sizing note to set expectations before the QBR:

Summary recommendation based on your Mar–May extract:
- Baseline steady-state throughput: increase reserved capacity by ~2x (model concurrency + token throughput).
- Peak buffer: provision burst credits to absorb ~4x spikes; configure continuous batching with conservative latency SLOs for traffic surges.
- Migration window: 7–14 days to validate caching/kv-warm paths, run a 2-week staged pilot with limited tenant traffic (we can schedule a 2-week dedicated burst window).

Estimated monthly unit delta (ballpark):
- Option A (12m, reserved 2x): +$26k/mo (after commit discount)
- Option B (24m, reserved 2x): +$18k/mo (larger commit discount)
- Pilot (2-week dedicated burst): one-off setup fee $4k + prorated burst consumption.

I'm attaching the term sheet draft with the pricing lines and a short ops checklist for the pilot. We'll review these in detail at the QBR.

— Marcus
